scope: RefLog Browser, Branch, Tag and Export immutable selected-revision handoffs, source current-stash/index-parent creation gates and Browser/Export reuse predicates. Partial parity; full macOS port remains incomplete.

verification.native: Final receiver passed system Git, Git 2.37.1, 2.39.5 and bundled 2.55.0. Four exact-one immutable callbacks load actual older-revision Browser tree/blob, Branch/Tag base choosers and whole-project Export without automatic creation/export. Missing callbacks, empty/invalid/multi/busy selection, revision chooser creation and current/older stash plus adjacent two-parent index gates verified. Original icon mapping verified. Production reuse helpers reject changed revision, busy/invalid Browser, mismatched loaded snapshot and changed Export destination/scope. HEAD/refs/index/config/worktree byte-exact preserved by reads. No displayed UI, general clipboard or preference writes.
verification.regression: General RefLog deletion receiver passed all four Git versions after factory reuse changes. It retains real reverse-index deletion, full branch-log removal without ref movement, stale-after-confirmation rejection, stash Drop/Clear, chooser gates and actual hidden default-button alerts. That regression predates only the final extra Browser snapshot-revision predicate; final handoff receiver tests that predicate directly. No physical prompt clicks.
verification.iterations: Initial Debug and both four-Git matrices passed. Found Browser/Export factory reuse could retain edited state, added matching idle model predicates and independent owned keys; Debug and both native matrices passed. Added loaded Browser snapshot-revision gate and receiver fixture for an edited revision with an unrefreshed different tree; final Debug and four-Git handoff matrix passed. No failed build/native iteration. Before-refinement logs retained.
verification.builds: Final unsigned Debug and AppStore builds, both bundle audits and byte-exact bundled NOTICE comparisons passed. All 96 original icons verified. Store --require-git audited 11 universal Git Mach-O files and real fixture operations. EditorConfig/IssueRegex audits passed.
verification.core: No Core source changed; real Git/native receivers exercise existing Core APIs. No additional Core suite run for this checkpoint.
verification.documentation: RefLog parity, PORTING summary and pinned source inventory updated. Inventory pin check and 3277 seven-column source rows validated. NOTICE attribution added. Local documentation site generated; unpublished.
verification.ci: Native handoff receiver added to macOS workflow. Hosted CI/authentication/push unavailable and unverified; no retry.
verification.processes: All compiler/build/native/audit sessions terminal. Main GUI never launched. Handoff receiver displays no windows; deletion receiver uses only hidden native alerts. Final app/native receiver process audit empty.

This is callback/model/Git evidence, not physical window acceptance.
